Title: Azure Cosmos DB: Azure CLI support for autoscale

Body.Content: Now in general availability, we are announcing Azure CLI support for autoscale in Azure Cosmos DB. Use Azure CLI to provision new Azure Cosmos DB database and container-level resources with autoscale throughput, as well as change maximum throughput. Migration from standard to autoscale throughput will be released in an upcoming version. To learn more and try this out for yourself, see the Azure Cosmos DB CLI samples.
